999008199.text: そうかい。ゴゥはそっち側につくのかい

localizations.en: I see. So Gou, you're siding with them.

999008199.text:
そっち側というのは、正確ではありません。
私だって彼らを救いたい気持ちは同じです

localizations.en: Saying I'm siding with them isn't fair. I want to save these people just as much as you do.

999008199.text:
いいや、違うね。盲信的に任務に従う……
それじゃあね、行きつく先は昔のアタシなんだ

localizations.en: No, you're wrong. Following orders blindly like that... that's the path I used to walk.

999008199.text:
この鱗吹雪の龍の力、見せるのがお前さんたちとは
因果なものだね

localizations.en: How ironic that I'd be showing you folks the power of this Scale Blizzard Dragon.

999008199.text:
姉上、やめたほうがいい。
いくら姉上でも１対３では……

localizations.en: Sister, you should stop. Even with your strength, it's three against one...

999008199.text:
ぐちぐちと、お尻をペンペンされるのが怖いのかい？
さあ来なよ、ひよっこども！

localizations.en: What's with all the whining? Are you scared of getting your butts kicked? Come on then, rookies!

999008199.text:
任務遂行への障害へと判断。
撃退します

localizations.en: Judging this as an obstacle to mission completion. Engaging to eliminate threat.

999008199.text: お、おい！
ちょいなッ！
なっ！？

あらら、キマっちゃってるねぇ、これ。
本気でかからなきゃヤバいかも

localizations.en: Whoa, she's really going all out now. We might need to get serious if we want to handle this.

999008199.text: きょうだいで争うなんて……！！

戦力差は歴然だったはずなのに、
なぜこれほど薄氷を踏む勝利に……

localizations.en: The difference in our combat strength should have been obvious, so why was this such a narrow victory...

999008199.text:
強烈な意地っ張り……多分イェルカの信じる
粋ってやつだったんだろうね

localizations.en: That fierce stubbornness... it was probably what Jelka calls chicness.

999008199.text:
……姉上の思想は私とは相容れない。
だが……少し、気持ちは分かる気がする

localizations.en: Jelka's philosophy is incompatible with mine. But... I think I understand her feelings, a little.

999008199.text:
こんな酷い目にあっている人たちがいる島を
後回しにしなくてはいけないのだから……

localizations.en: Having to put an island full of people suffering like this on the back burner...

999008199.text:
罪人を一般市民と同じ地には住まわせられません。
このような流刑地としての島は必要悪かと

localizations.en: We cannot allow criminals to live alongside ordinary citizens. Islands like this that serve as places of exile are a necessary evil.

999008199.text:
天然の牢獄って感じだよね。でも、ある程度自由に
生活できるんだからいいほうかもよ？

localizations.en: It's like a natural prison. But hey, at least they get to live free, right?

999008199.text:
だが……はびこる魔物を「管理」したとはいえ、
このままではいずれ、香の中毒でこの島は滅びる

localizations.en: Even though we managed the monsters that were running rampant, this island will eventually perish from incense addiction if things continue as they are.

999008199.text:
そうなる前に、他の優先すべき任務をすべて片付けて
この島に戻ってこよう。それが私のすべき戦いだ

localizations.en: Before that happens, I'll finish all our higher priority missions and come back for them. That's the fight in front of me right now.

999008199.text:
もっと強くなって……
目に見えるものすべてを守れるくらいに、強く……

localizations.en: I need to become stronger... strong enough to protect everything I can see...
